reviews.comment: Schobert is a GREAT PROF!!! Class was interesting, all you have to do is the work, and the tests are easy, just have to look over the slideshows and memorize. You do have to get a book to do the guided readings, but they are easy. Would take her again and over!! Attendance is not mandatory, but I recommend going to class every day.

Literally my favorite class I took at TAMU. Not only is it easy to do well in like classes should be, but Schobert goes out of her way to get guest lecturers, advertise opportunities,and encourage people in their equine journey. She's got lots of connections and worth getting to know her! Good class for both experienced horseman and new to industry

One of the sweetest professors I have had for a class. I took the online portion and it was very easy to manage. Exams require a lockdown browser. Her lecture videos are very helpful since she tells you what will for sure be on the exam. There are two projects but are not too time consuming. I highly recommend her and this class 100%!!!

I adore professor Schobert. She is extremely passionate about what she does, and while the class I took was introductory level and I already knew most all of the content, she did a good job of keeping everyone engaged. Her tests have a fair amount of "trick questions" and you NEED to have access to a printer as she doesn't accept digital turn in.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Schobert ran the equine internship course really well. There are discussion posts, hour logs, and activity surveys to monitor your internship progress. The questions she asks in the surveys really make you think about what kind of employee you are and how you can improve. Highly suggest taking this course for credit during your internship
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Schobert! Her class was easy and exams were straight from the notes/lectures. She's super funny and tells engaging stories that make her lectures fun. Attendance is required through TopHat, but she also hosts the class on zoom so you can attend lecture from home if you really wanted to.

Was such an easy blow off class, but Schobert can be kind of annoying. Her lectures go off topic ALOT, and she talks all about her knowledge so it can be boring. BUT, the class and material is so so easy, if you don't get an A, Its not Schoberts fault.

She is an amazing teacher who really knows her stuff! I have increased my love for horses from her class as well as receiving a lot of equine working opportunities. Her class is not hard as long as you pay attention and take notes and study. her tests are really straight forward from her powerpoints and have simple extra credit as long as you read!

Schobert is great! She knows her stuff and also admits what she doesn't know. This is an easy, fun class for both seasoned horseman and people who have never seen a horse. Didn't have to study too much. Tests are exactly like slides. 4 quizzes. In class participation Qs like Iclicker. Guest speakers. Readings. Zooms all her lectures.

Schobert gives great lectures and tells so many fun stories that help you learn! I've been riding for about 5 years and learned so much in this class, but I would also recommend it to people with zero horse experience. The exams were very fair, but if you don't attend lecture they would be much harder. Overall, great prof and great class.

Loved this class. learned a lot. Not very much homework- only 3 exams- and some chapter fill in the blanks. Super easy going and the lectures are very engaging. I loved her!! She brings in amazing guest speakers and keeps the class alive. She is very informed! I highly advise to take any of the classes she teaches!
She was really rude and acted like a know it all.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is easy and helps a lot if you're also taking 107 and 108. The subjects have a lot of the same material, which makes studying that much more effective. Just make sure you pay attention because there are clicker questions throughout each class. The assignments are easy, including the reading. She offers extra credit sometimes.

Prof Schobert is awesome. I grew up raising horses and this class was still enough to push me to learn more, even as an introductory course. She is motivating and her passion for what she does makes class so good. Take this class even if it's just for fun. You will enjoy it.

Schobert is great! I had no prior equine knowledge or experience before this class and I learned so much. The book assigned was very interesting and homework was easy. If you study right for the tests you'll do fine. She offers extra credit. Professor Schobert tells great stories along with her lectures! Highly recommend this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sarah Schobert is an amazing professor. Not only does she genuinely make you interested in equine care with her real experience in the field and her humor, she is also very understanding when it comes to grading. Her exams are all from her lectures which she posts the slides, which makes studying for them very doable. I'd definitely take her again.

Schobert made this class very engaging and she always had a real-world story to tell, greatly adding to your learning. No matter your equine background, this course will 100% teach you something. There are reading HW's based on a textbook. The exams require studying but are very doable. In-class participation counts towards your grade as well.
Great prof! Lectures get interesting. tests are straight forward. She does do clicker questions that are taken for a grade.

Attendance points, 3 Exams, quizzes, homework and a final. Attendance matters for points. You will need a book for homework that you can easily get at library for the very easy homework over the chapters. Fun HW Gamble. Study for quizzes and you will be fine. Very knowledgeable and does not just read slides but adds to them from experience.

Schobert was such an amazing professor! Her lectures were so interesting and I actually enjoyed going to class. Her tests are very doable, but you have to study. Listen in lecture and take notes! She made me feel cared for as a student and more informed when it comes to a future in equine medicine. Seriously take this class if you can!

Schobert is super fun and chill. Her homework was straightforward and was done using a pretty interesting book written by an equine vet. I really enjoyed her perspective and stories on the equine industry. Show up to class and study 1-2 hours a week and you should get an A on every test.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor and has a lot of knowledge in the equine industry, she always tells stories in class, which makes lectures interesting. Her exams are word for word in the powerpoint and super easy!

Super great prof loved being in her class. Lectures were fun and she still got though all the material without being boring. Always has a story about what she's talking about to show a real world example. She prepares you really well for tests so if you pay attention and study a bit you'll ace it no problem.

She was awesome. The class was well balanced with tests and assignments. Coming to class was important because you have to answer questions during it. She is a fun professor, and she wants you to learn.

Dr. Schobert is great! She is very knowledgeable and knows what she is talking about. She has done just about every discipline so she has a wide range of knowledge. It is a good class for both people that know a lot about horses and the ones that do not. The class is not hard at all, all her quiz and test questions are in her PowerPoints.

She knows what she's talking about and will admit if she isn't sure on something you ask. Entertaining lectures and the work is easy enough for those who have never worked with horses but even if you have for years, you'll learn something new. Questions during lectures go towards your grade, homework is rare and not difficult.
